bands.name: Lower
bands.guidance: Immediate structured intervention. Re-teach prerequisite concepts with concrete and visual representations.

bands.name: Cuspy
bands.guidance: Targeted short intervention. Address two or three misconceptions, then reassess within two weeks.

bands.name: Expected
bands.guidance: Secure core understanding. Revisit any domain below half marks and continue mixed retrieval.

bands.name: Higher
bands.guidance: Strong understanding. Use proof, generalisation and unfamiliar multi-step problems for depth.
